Description: Encapsulates one bus transaction to Cycle Counter registers. Holds address (CTRL/STATUS/CNT_LO/CNT_HI), data, write-enable, write strobes, and captured read data.
Key_Methods: new(); convert2string(); do_copy(); do_compare(); do_print(); randomize()
Signals_Used: addr[7:0], data[31:0], we, wstrb[3:0], rdata[31:0], ready, err

Description: Pulls sequence items from the sequencer and drives the virtual bus interface signals. Handles handshake: asserts req, waits for ready, samples rdata/err, deasserts req.
Signals_Used: clk, rst_n, bus_req, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_wdata, bus_wstrb, bus_ready, bus_rdata, bus_err

Description: Passively observes the bus interface. On each posedge clk, samples req & ready; when both asserted captures address/data/we/rdata/err into a seq_item and writes to analysis port. Also contains embedded covergroup.
Signals_Used: clk, bus_req, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_wdata, bus_wstrb, bus_ready, bus_rdata, bus_err

Description: Standard UVM sequencer parameterised on cycle_cnt_seq_item. Arbitrates between multiple sequence objects wanting to drive the driver.
Container for driver, monitor, and sequencer. When is_active==UVM_ACTIVE instantiates driver and sequencer and connects them. Monitor always instantiated.
Reference model for Cycle Counter. Tracks expected 64-bit count based on EN, CLEAR, and elapsed clock cycles. Verifies CNT_LO/HI reads, shadow latch behaviour, and STATUS accuracy.
Key_Methods: write_wr(cycle_cnt_seq_item item); write_rd(cycle_cnt_seq_item item); check_phase(); predict_count()

Description: Embedded covergroup inside cycle_cnt_monitor. Samples address, we, and cross(addr,we) on every captured transaction.
Abstract base sequence. Provides shared utility tasks: do_write(addr,data), do_read(addr) returning rdata.
Writes CTRL=0x01 to enable counting. Optionally reads STATUS to confirm RUNNING=1.
Writes CTRL=0x02 (CLEAR pulse) then reads CNT_LO/CNT_HI to verify both are zero.
Enables counter, waits N clocks, then performs atomic CNT_LO read followed by CNT_HI read. Passes both values to scoreboard for consistency check.
Uses backdoor (uvm_config_db or hierarchical reference) to preset counter near 64-bit maximum, then enables and waits for wrap. Checks CNT_LO/HI post-wrap.
